candidates.reason: The headline is undersized and pushed into the lower half, so the can circle dominates the top. The badges are oversized and compete with the CTA, which drifts off right of the text column. Legal copy is jammed against the badges and the bottom ~50px of the canvas is dead space.

A shrunk copy of the banner floating in the middle: the body copy, badges and legal text are illegibly tiny, and huge empty bands top and bottom waste the format. It is not rearranged for the square at all.

The product can is shrunk to a tiny icon wedged beside the CTA, losing the key imagery. The badges are stacked bottom-left and cut off from the body copy, and the legal text sits in a cramped corner. Left edges are ragged, and the headline has a big empty left margin.

The strongest restructure: a full-width headline at the top, then copy, a clear CTA and the can with badges in reading order. Flaws: the can is shrunk in a cropped circle, the badge pair is off-axis from the CTA, and the legal text is tiny and cramped at the bottom right. The left column feels squeezed.
